work_type_values: GRADE, DRAIN, BASE, PAVE AND BRG
projects.notes: WEAK FIT. This is ALDOT's whole project inventory (20,733 line records, old and new), not a planned-projects list. It has NO status, date, fiscal year, cost or county field, so planned work cannot be told apart from completed work using this layer alone. SCPE_ID is the project scope/phase code of each record (PE = preliminary engineering, RW = right of way, UT = utilities, CN = construction, others undocumented on the service); records with SCPE_ID = 'RW' are right-of-way projects but with no date. PJ_FAMLY_ID groups the phases of one project; PRIOR_PE_ID links to the PE record. County can be derived only from geometry. It would need to be joined by PJ_REF_ID / PROJECT_CODE to ALDOT's STIP listing (published as documents, no verified GIS service found). maxRecordCount 1000.

parcels_counties.notes: Mobile County Revenue Commission public parcels. Owner in Name1 with Name2 as second line (e.g. 'ATTN: ...'). NO mailing address and no value: the Prop* fields are the property location. Text is padded with trailing spaces; trim. KeyNum / Account_Number are the revenue keys. (Layer 0 of this service is road centerlines.)
City/County of Montgomery. OwnerName2 is the second owner. TotalLandValue, TotalImpValue; RecordYear; InstDate. Text is padded with trailing spaces; trim.

Tuscaloosa County (ArcGIS Online, updated November 2026). 'Name' also holds the parcel number; ppin is the property index number; AddlNames = additional owners; rtDEED_ACR deeded acres. The add* fields look like the owner's mailing address (sample: city TUSCALOOSA, ZIP 35403 for a rural parcel) but this is inferred from one record; confirm on more records.

parcels_counties.notes: Baldwin County Revenue Commission parcels. PID is the formatted parcel number, PPIN/PIN the property index number; TTV total value (CLandValue + CImpValue), TAV assessed; PreviousOwner; DeedRecorded; TaxYearDue 2027 in the sample. Spatial query at Daphne returned 37 parcels. One request got a connection reset and succeeded on retry: go slowly. maxRecordCount 2000. County parcel viewer disclaimer read (warranty/accuracy only: "No warranty or representation is made as to the accuracy and availability of said information"); it states no limit on commercial use, resale or mailing lists. Hosted by the county's GIS vendor (KCS); this is the service the county's public parcel viewer calls. The viewer page loads reCAPTCHA and some sibling KCS services answer 'Token Required', but this endpoint answered every request without a token; it could be closed later.

summary: Projects: ALDOT publishes project geometry with description, work type and phase code but no dates, status or cost, so it cannot by itself identify planned work. Parcels: no statewide layer; Mobile (owner only), Montgomery and Tuscaloosa county layers are verified; Jefferson refused automated access.
parcels_statewide_reason: No free statewide Alabama parcel layer was found (ArcGIS Online catalog search returned none; parcels are published by county revenue offices).
parcels_counties_not_found: Jefferson (Birmingham): https://jccgis.jccal.org/server/rest/services/Basemap/Parcels/MapServer/0 answered HTTP 403 to an automated request. Madison (Huntsville) and Baldwin: no public parcel service with owner names found in the time allowed.
parcels_statewide_recheck: Rechecked 2026-11-17: still no official statewide Alabama parcel layer. The only statewide-looking item found, 'Alabama Parcel Data' (https://services6.arcgis.com/VUsVQlvugJlIRS3I/arcgis/rest/services/Alabama_Parcel_Data/FeatureServer, posted by a utility's account), is a per-county re-upload of a commercial parcel vendor's product (vendor id fields LL_UUID / LL_GISACRE), not a government publication; it was not recorded.

parcels_recheck_note: County parcel recheck 2026-11-17. Every entry dated 2026-11-17 passed three live requests: layer metadata, one sample record, and a 200 m point spatial query. Many county-run servers did not answer at all from the network used for this check (connection timeouts), so 'not verified' below often means unreachable from here, not absent; retry from a U.S. network.
